outcome: Weekly respiratory symptoms during the first year of life
Infant lung function at 5 weeks of age
Incidence of wheezing at school age
Lung function parameters at school age
cohort: 578 children born at ≥37 weeks of gestation from a prospective birth cohort study
finding: Cesarean delivery was not associated with increased respiratory symptoms in the first year of life or with different respiratory or atopic outcomes at school age compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not associated with different respiratory or atopic outcomes at school age compared with vaginal delivery.
